note: Issue 404, the two-voice month: the other voice beside steward.request_tax_rise, in the same post. The Steward proposes a firmer rate and says the colony will hardly notice; this governor's town trades the very resource, and he says it will. There is nothing to answer here - the decision is the Steward's letter, and the PC is the arbiter between them. Placeholder prose.

body.text: I understand the Steward means to write to you about the duty on {param:resource}. I thought you had better hear from somebody who has to pay it.
This town deals in {param:resource} every month. Put the rate up and it is my people who find the difference, not the Treasury, and they will not find it quietly.
I do not tell you what to decide. I only ask that you decide it knowing this.
I expect you will do as the Steward says. I wanted it on paper that you were told.
